subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: ROOT CAUSE NOT ADDRESSED: The prescribed minimal fix requires modifying ContentstackProvider in src/context/contentstackContext.tsx — replacing the static useMemo with React.useState and wiring the @contentstack/live-preview-utils onEntryChange callback so CMS preview edits propagate to the React tree. The diff does NOT touch this file at all. Instead, the diff adds a useLivePreview hook that reads isLivePreview and previewToken from ContentstackContext, but since the context file was never modified, these properties do not exist on the context interface — this is a TypeScript error and the hook will return undefined at runtime. The entire change set is tangential to the root cause: the provider still freezes content on mount and no live preview update can ever reach the UI.
issues.suggestedFix: Implement the prescribed fix in src/context/contentstackContext.tsx: (1) Add @contentstack/live-preview-utils as a dependency. (2) Replace the static useMemo that freezes defaultContent with React.useState initialized to defaultContent. (3) Call onEntryChange from the Live Preview SDK and update state in the callback so the entire context tree re-renders with preview content. (4) Add live_preview_hash param to the server-side Contentstack API fetch calls so draft/preview entries are returned. Then the useLivePreview hook can read isLivePreview/previewToken from the context if you add them to the context value.

issues.description: useLivePreview destructures { isLivePreview, previewToken } from useContext(ContentstackContext), but the context interface was never updated to include these properties. This is a TypeScript strict-mode error (Property 'isLivePreview' does not exist on the context type). The hook is non-functional.
issues.suggestedFix: Either add isLivePreview and previewToken to the ContentstackContext interface and provider value (as part of the prescribed provider fix), or remove this hook entirely if the provider fix makes it unnecessary.

issues.description: withPreviewFlag hand-rolls URL query-parameter manipulation (splitting on '#', checking for '?', string concatenation). This is reinventing URL parsing logic that the project likely already has a helper for. Additionally, the function does not handle edge cases properly: if the URL already contains a 'preview' parameter, it appends a duplicate; it does not use the URL API which is the standard, safe approach. The prescribed fix does not call for URL decoration on ContentstackLink at all — the live_preview_hash param belongs on the server-side Contentstack API fetch, not on rendered anchor hrefs.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove withPreviewFlag and the isPreview prop/badge from ContentstackLink entirely — they are not part of the prescribed minimal fix. The live preview reactivity should be handled at the provider level (ContentstackProvider), not by decorating individual link components.

issues.description: isPreview and previewTimestamp fields added to IContentCard are not part of the prescribed fix and have no consumers in the diff. The prescribed fix explicitly states 'The context shape (IContentstackContent) does not need to change.' Adding unused fields to unrelated interfaces is scope creep that increases maintenance surface without addressing the root cause.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove isPreview and previewTimestamp from IContentCard. They are not needed for the live preview fix.

issues.description: NO TESTS: The new useLivePreview hook has no corresponding vitest unit tests. The new withPreviewFlag helper in ContentstackLink.tsx also has no tests. Per review criteria, new features must have corresponding tests in test/unit/ mirroring the src/ path, and the total test count must not decrease.
issues.suggestedFix: Add unit tests for any code that remains after implementing the prescribed fix. If useLivePreview and withPreviewFlag are removed (as recommended), this is moot. If the provider fix is implemented, add tests verifying that onEntryChange callback updates context state and triggers re-render.

issues.description: useLivePreview function lacks an explicit return type annotation. Per TypeScript strict compliance criteria, all function return types should be explicitly typed.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an explicit return type, e.g.: export const useLivePreview = (): { isLivePreview: boolean; previewToken: string } => { ... }

issues.description: Hardcoded string 'Live Preview' and 'contentstack-link__preview-badge' class name. Per review criteria, hardcoded strings should use named constants. However, since this code should be removed per the prescribed fix, this is moot if removed.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove this code as it is not part of the prescribed minimal fix.

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: DOES NOT IMPLEMENT THE PRESCRIBED ROOT CAUSE FIX. The prescribed minimal fix was: replace the static useMemo with useState initialized from defaultContent, and register onEntryChange to call setContent with the updated entry — making the context reactive. The diff instead keeps content as a static value via useMemo([defaultContent, isPreviewMode]) and delegates to an external onEntryChange callback described in its own JSDoc as 'typically router.replace(router.asPath)'. router.replace IS a page reload, not a reactive in-place update. This directly violates AC #2 ('updates without requiring a manual page reload'), AC #4 ('continues to display the last-rendered content without errors'), and AC #5 ('updates to show the reverted value'). The onEntryChange handler (line 102) calls onEntryChangeRef.current?.() but never updates any content state — the context value never changes in response to CMS edits.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the static useMemo with: const [content, setContent] = useState<IContentstackContext>(defaultContent); Then in the onEntryChange handler, call setContent with the updated entry data from the Live Preview SDK. Remove the external onEntryChange callback prop entirely — the provider should own the content state and update it reactively, as prescribed. The minimal fix is ~10-15 lines, not 131.

issues.description: NO UNIT TESTS. resolve_test_file found zero existing test files for contentstackContext.tsx, and the diff includes no test files. New features require corresponding vitest unit tests in test/unit/ mirroring the src/ path. None of the 5 acceptance criteria have any test coverage.
issues.suggestedFix: Add test/unit/context/contentstackContext.spec.tsx (or src/context/__tests__/contentstackContext.spec.tsx per codebase convention) with tests covering: (1) non-preview mode renders default content unchanged, (2) entry change updates rendered content without page reload, (3) multiple simultaneous field changes each propagate, (4) session end preserves last-rendered content, (5) revert to published value updates the rendered page.

issues.description: unsubscribeOnEntryChange API MISMATCH. The dependency's type declaration (node_modules/@contentstack/live-preview-utils/dist/modern/light-sdk.d.ts) shows 'static unsubscribeOnEntryChange(): void' — it takes NO parameters. The diff calls ContentstackLivePreview.unsubscribeOnEntryChange(unsubscribeUid) with an argument. The argument is silently ignored at runtime, so the unsubscribe will not target the specific callback UID. The return type of onEntryChange is OnEntryChangeCallbackUID (a string), but unsubscribeOnEntryChange does not accept it.
issues.suggestedFix: Check the actual SDK API. If unsubscribeOnEntryChange truly takes no args, it likely unsubscribes all listeners — call it without arguments. If per-callback unsubscribe is needed, verify whether the SDK supports it via a different method or return value.

issues.description: ContentstackProvider IS NEVER USED. A search across the entire src/ directory found zero imports or usages of ContentstackProvider. The diff adds 131 lines of new component code but nothing wires it in to replace the existing bare <ContentstackContext.Provider> usage. The Live Preview feature is dead code — no page will actually use it.
issues.suggestedFix: Find and update all existing usages of <ContentstackContext.Provider value={...}> to use <ContentstackProvider defaultContent={...}> instead. At minimum, update the app-level _app.tsx or equivalent wrapper that provides content to the component tree.

issues.description: OVER-ENGINEERED vs PRESCRIBED MINIMAL FIX. The prescribed fix was: useState for content + onEntryChange → setContent (~10-15 lines). The diff adds 131 lines: an external callback prop pattern, isPreviewMode flag, useRef for callback management, async init with try/catch, cleanup logic, and extensive JSDoc. A more concise change: const [content, setContent] = useState(defaultContent); useEffect(() => { if (typeof window === 'undefined') return; ContentstackLivePreview.init(); ContentstackLivePreview.onEntryChange(() => setContent(updatedEntry)); }, []); — fewer lines, meets all ACs, no external callback indirection.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the onEntryChange callback prop, isPreviewMode flag, onEntryChangeRef, and the async setupPreview wrapper. Replace with a simple useState + useEffect that calls setContent directly in the onEntryChange handler.

issues.description: Malformed/truncated comment: 'On the server and in production this component is effectively a thin pass-through around `<Content is unchanged.' — the sentence is cut off mid-word.
issues.suggestedFix: Complete the comment: 'thin pass-through around <ContentstackContext.Provider>.'

subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: ContentstackProvider is never mounted anywhere in the application. Codegraph query for 'ContentstackProvider' returned no results. All 20+ existing consumers (tests and components) use ContentstackContext.Provider directly (e.g., Header.spec.tsx, Footer.spec.tsx, Layout.spec.tsx, NewsListingContainer.spec.tsx, etc.). The new provider with its live-preview subscription logic is dead code — the onEntryChange subscription never runs, so none of the 7 acceptance criteria are met. The RCA explicitly states 'ContentstackProvider is the single source of content truth for the entire app — all 236+ components access content via useContent → useContentstackContext → ContentstackContext', but the diff introduces a new wrapper that nothing wraps with.
issues.suggestedFix: Either (a) wire ContentstackProvider into the app's root layout (_app.tsx or equivalent) so it wraps the entire component tree, replacing the raw ContentstackContext.Provider usage, or (b) integrate the live-preview subscription logic directly into the existing context setup that components already consume, rather than creating a new unused Provider component.

issues.description: The onEntryChange callback discards the entry data from the SDK. The implementation is `LivePreview.onEntryChange(() => { setPreviewOverrides((prev) => ({ ...prev })); })` — it spreads the previous (always empty) state into a new object and ignores the callback parameter. The Contentstack Live Preview SDK's onEntryChange callback receives the updated entry data as an argument; this implementation never captures it. Even if ContentstackProvider were mounted, previewOverrides would always be {}.
issues.suggestedFix: Capture the entry data from the callback: `LivePreview.onEntryChange((entry) => { setPreviewOverrides(entry); })` or merge it appropriately. The callback parameter contains the draft entry content that must be stored in state.

issues.description: Override key mismatch: useContent looks up overrides by the dotted path string (e.g., 'page.0.page_components.0.Attention_Block.attention_block_heading'), but the Contentstack Live Preview SDK provides structured entry data (the full entry object), not a flat map of dotted-path keys to values. The hasOwnProperty check against livePreview[path] will never match because the SDK does not produce a flat dotted-path-keyed dictionary. This means even with correct onEntryChange data capture, no override would ever be found.
issues.suggestedFix: Either (a) flatten the SDK's entry data into a dotted-path map before storing in previewOverrides, or (b) change the lookup to traverse the structured entry data using the path. Reuse the existing getValue utility for the traversal: `getValue(livePreview, path, getValue(content, path, defaultValue))`.

issues.description: No server-side Contentstack Stack configuration. The RCA explicitly prescribes: 'the server-side Contentstack Stack initialization must be configured with live_preview: { enable: true, preview_token: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, host: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST } so that preview queries return draft content.' This is entirely absent from the diff. Without it, the SDK cannot fetch draft content, so onEntryChange would never deliver preview data even if the callback were correct.
issues.suggestedFix: Locate the Contentstack Stack initialization (likely in cx-shared or an API util) and add the live_preview configuration with enable, preview_token, and host from environment variables. Use named constants from src/config/constants.ts for the env var names.

issues.description: No unit tests for ContentstackProvider. The diff adds a new React component with useEffect, dynamic import, and state management, but no test file exists for it. The resolve_test_file tool and grep found no test file at test/unit/context/ or co-located __tests__/. Per review criteria, new features must have corresponding vitest unit tests mirroring the src/ path. The ContentstackLink.spec.ts tests only verify the link component with manually-mocked context values — they do not test the provider's subscription lifecycle, onEntryChange wiring, or graceful degradation when the SDK is unavailable.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test file (e.g., src/context/__tests__/contentstackContext.spec.tsx) that verifies: (1) ContentstackProvider renders children, (2) onEntryChange is called when preview URL params are present, (3) state updates propagate to consumers, (4) graceful fallback when SDK import fails, (5) no subscription when preview params absent (production).

issues.description: useEffect cleanup does not unsubscribe from onEntryChange. The cleanup sets `cancelled = true` but never calls the SDK's unsubscribe/cleanup method. If ContentstackProvider unmounts and remounts (e.g., route changes in Next.js), multiple onEntryChange listeners accumulate, causing duplicate state updates and potential memory leaks. The @contentstack/live-preview-utils SDK typically returns an unsubscribe function from onEntryChange or provides an onEntryChange cleanup method.
issues.suggestedFix: Capture the return value of LivePreview.onEntryChange() (if it returns an unsubscribe function) and call it in the useEffect cleanup, or call LivePreview.unsubscribe()/LivePreview.cleanup() if available.

issues.description: Hardcoded query parameter strings. 'live_preview', 'entry_uid', 'content_type_uid' are hardcoded string literals. Per review criteria (criterion 6), no hardcoded strings — all should use named constants from src/config/constants.ts.
issues.suggestedFix: Define constants like LIVE_PREVIEW_PARAM, ENTRY_UID_PARAM, CONTENT_TYPE_UID_PARAM in src/config/constants.ts and import them.

issues.description: Silent .catch(() => {}) swallows all errors with no logging. While graceful degradation is intended, this masks real configuration errors (e.g., SDK installed but misconfigured) during development. The RCA states 'SDK not installed or initialisation failed; fall back gracefully' but silent failure makes debugging impossible.
issues.suggestedFix: At minimum, log a warning in development: `.catch((err) => { if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') console.warn('Live Preview SDK init failed:', err); })`.

issues.description: Unsafe type assertion `livePreview[path] as T` bypasses TypeScript's type safety. The value from the override bag is `unknown` (from Record<string, unknown>), and casting it directly to T without validation could introduce runtime type errors if the SDK delivers data in an unexpected shape. This violates TypeScript strict compliance criteria.
issues.suggestedFix: Either validate the shape before casting, or use a type guard, or at minimum add an explanatory comment per the review criteria ('no untyped any without an explanatory comment' — the same principle applies to unsafe casts).

issues.description: The added comment block (lines 20-22) is explanatory but redundant — it describes mechanism (how live preview works) rather than intent. The code is self-documenting via the getContentByKey call. This adds 3 lines of comment to a 25-line component.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the comment or reduce to a single line if any clarification is needed.

issues.description: Listed as a relevant file in the review task but has no changes in the diff. The file defines IContentCard and IContentCardsList interfaces. If card reordering (acceptance criterion 7) requires changes to how card lists are consumed or rendered, the interface may need a live-preview-aware accessor, but since the root cause is in the provider/hook layer, no changes here may be needed. Confirm this file was listed in error or if changes were intended.
issues.suggestedFix: No action needed if the provider-level fix correctly propagates card list changes. Remove from relevant files list if no changes were planned.

subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The onEntryChange callback discards the actual preview entry data. `setPreviewOverrides((prev) => ({ ...prev }))` creates a shallow clone of the existing state (always `{}`), ignoring the entry argument that the SDK passes to the callback. The `previewOverrides` state is therefore never populated with any content — it remains an empty object for the entire session. None of the 7 acceptance criteria about live updates can be satisfied because no override data ever reaches `useContent.getContentByKey`.
issues.suggestedFix: Capture the entry argument from onEntryChange and store it: `LivePreview.onEntryChange((entry) => { if (!cancelled) setPreviewOverrides(entry); });` — or whatever shape the SDK delivers, then transform it to match the dotted-path lookup used in useContent.

issues.description: The override lookup assumes `livePreview` is a flat Record keyed by the same dotted-path strings (e.g. `page[0].card[0].card_title`) that `getValue` uses to traverse the published content tree. Contentstack's onEntryChange delivers a structured entry object (the full entry JSON), not a flat map of dotted paths. Even if the entry data were stored (fixing the blocker above), `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(livePreview, path)` will never match because the path format and the entry shape are incompatible. The prescribed fix says to 'merge defaultContent with live preview updates' — a deep merge into the content tree, not a flat key lookup.
issues.suggestedFix: Deep-merge the preview entry into the content object (or into the relevant subtree) so that getValue traverses through preview data naturally. Alternatively, flatten the entry to the dotted-path format before storing it in previewOverrides. Either way, the lookup mechanism must be consistent with the data shape stored.

issues.description: The prescribed fix requires server-side Contentstack Stack initialization to be configured with `live_preview: { enable: true, preview_token: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, host: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST }` so that preview queries return draft content. No such configuration appears in the diff. Without it, the SDK may initialize on the client but the Contentstack API will never return draft/preview content, making the entire feature non-functional end-to-end.
issues.suggestedFix: Locate the Contentstack Stack initialization (likely in cx-shared or an API util) and add the live_preview configuration object with enable, preview_token, and host from environment variables.

issues.description: No unit tests exist for any of the changed files. resolve_test_file confirmed zero test files for contentstackContext.tsx, useContent.ts, or ContentstackLink.tsx. The review criteria require new features to have corresponding vitest unit tests mirroring the src/ path, and the total test count must not decrease. None of the 7 acceptance criteria are covered by tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Add test files at src/context/__tests__/contentstackContext.spec.tsx, src/hooks/__tests__/useContent.spec.ts, and src/components/contentstack/ContentstackLink/__tests__/ContentstackLink.spec.tsx covering: (1) preview overrides take precedence over published content, (2) fallback to published content when preview is off, (3) graceful degradation when SDK import fails, (4) link/card/image text updates without page reload.

issues.description: Hardcoded query parameter strings `"live_preview"`, `"entry_uid"`, `"content_type_uid"` violate the no-hardcoded-strings criterion. These should use named constants from src/config/constants.ts.
issues.suggestedFix: Define constants for these query parameter names in src/config/constants.ts and import them.

issues.description: The `.catch(() => { /* silent */ })` swallows the error completely with only a comment. While graceful degradation is correct behavior, the catch block should at minimum log a warning (e.g. console.warn) so developers can diagnose why Live Preview is not working during development. A completely silent failure makes debugging impossible.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `console.warn('Contentstack Live Preview SDK failed to load:', err);` in the catch block.

subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: Over-engineered implementation far exceeds the prescribed minimal fix. The prescribed fix is: add a useState/useReducer in the existing ContentstackProvider, subscribe to onEntryChange, and merge preview data into the existing ContentstackContext value. Instead, the implementation adds a separate ContentstackPreviewContext, ContentstackPreviewState interface, IContentstackPreviewContext interface, resolvePreviewFlag(), resolvePreviewToken(), LivePreviewUtilsLike interface, stackDetails prop, and a dual-context pattern. A more concise change (~30-40 lines modifying the existing provider's useMemo to merge preview state) would meet all 7 acceptance criteria. Fewer lines of code is always better.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove ContentstackPreviewContext, ContentstackPreviewState, IContentstackPreviewContext, resolvePreviewFlag, resolvePreviewToken, LivePreviewUtilsLike, and the dual-context pattern. Instead, in the existing ContentstackProvider, add a single useState<Record<string, unknown>>({}) for preview overrides, subscribe to onEntryChange in a useEffect, deep-merge the received entry into the existing context value via useMemo, and export that merged value through the existing ContentstackContext.Provider.

issues.description: Shallow merge instead of deep merge. `{ ...(content ?? {}), ...overrides }` replaces entire top-level keys (e.g. the whole `page` array) rather than deep-merging preview data into the content tree. The prescribed fix says to 'merge defaultContent with live preview updates' — a deep merge. A shallow merge will lose nested published fields that aren't included in the preview entry, causing blank or missing content areas (violating AC #5 and #6).
issues.suggestedFix: Use a deep-merge utility to merge overrides into the content tree. Check codegraph_query for an existing deepMerge helper. If none exists, implement a targeted deep merge that overlays the preview entry's fields onto the corresponding nodes in the published content tree, preserving fields the preview entry doesn't include.

issues.description: No server-side Contentstack Stack configuration for live_preview. The prescribed fix explicitly requires the server-side Stack initialization to be configured with live_preview: { enable: true, preview_token: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, host: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST } so that preview queries return draft content. No such configuration appears in any of the changed files. Without it, the SDK may initialize on the client but the Contentstack API will never return draft/preview content, making the entire feature non-functional end-to-end.
issues.suggestedFix: Locate the server-side Contentstack Stack initialization (likely in cx-shared or a server-side API util) and add the live_preview configuration object with enable: true, preview_token from process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, and host from process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST.

issues.description: No unit tests exist for any of the 4 changed files. resolve_test_file confirmed zero test files for contentstackContext.tsx, useContent.ts, ContentstackLink.tsx, and contentCard.ts. The review criteria require new features to have corresponding vitest unit tests in test/unit/ mirroring the src/ path, and the total test count must not decrease. None of the 7 acceptance criteria are covered by tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Create test files at the recommended paths: src/context/__tests__/contentstackContext.spec.tsx, src/hooks/__tests__/useContent.spec.ts, and src/components/contentstack/ContentstackLink/__tests__/ContentstackLink.spec.tsx. Each test file should cover: (1) preview override merging for text fields, (2) image field updates, (3) link URL/display text updates, (4) card title/description updates, (5) fallback to published content when preview is inactive, (6) no preview indicators on production pages, (7) card list add/remove/reorder.

issues.description: The ContentCard interface and its JSDoc are unnecessary scope expansion. No acceptance criterion or prescribed fix step references a ContentCard interface. No other changed file imports it. This adds ~25 lines of code that do not contribute to meeting any AC.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the ContentCard interface and its JSDoc from contentCard.ts. Revert this file to its original state.

issues.description: The withPreviewParams function and its usage are unnecessary scope expansion. No acceptance criterion requires links to carry preview query params when navigated. The AC says links should reflect updated URL and display text from CMS edits — not that links should preserve preview state across navigation. This adds ~20 lines of code and a new useContentstackContext dependency that the prescribed fix does not call for.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove withPreviewParams, the useContentstackContext import, and the previewAwareHref useMemo. Revert ContentstackLink to use getContentByKey for href and title directly, which already picks up preview overrides through the content context.

issues.description: ContentstackProvider prop interface is breaking. The provider now requires defaultContent, contentType, entryUid, and stackDetails props that did not exist in the original IContentstackProviderProps (which had only children). All existing call sites that render <ContentstackProvider> would need to be updated. No evidence in the diff that these call sites were updated.
issues.suggestedFix: If the prescribed minimal fix is followed (modifying the existing provider in place), these new props are unnecessary. The existing provider already receives defaultContent via import and provides it through ContentstackContext. The preview subscription can be self-contained within the provider without new props.

issues.description: Duplicate import from the same module. `import { ContentstackContext } from 'context/contentstackContext'` and `import { useContentstackContext } from 'context/contentstackContext'` should be combined into a single import statement.
issues.suggestedFix: Combine into: import { ContentstackContext, useContentstackContext } from 'context/contentstackContext';

issues.description: Untyped `any` without explanatory comment: `footer?: [any]` in IContentstackContext violates TypeScript strict compliance. All types should be explicit or have an explanatory comment for any usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace `[any]` with a proper type, e.g. `[IContentstackFooter]` or add an explanatory comment: `footer?: [any]; // TODO: type with IContentstackFooter once interface is available`

subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The onEntryChange callback discards the actual preview entry data. `setLivePreviewContent((prev) => ({ ...prev }))` creates a shallow clone of existing state (always null/empty), ignoring any entry data the SDK provides. The livePreviewContent state is never populated with real content, so no live updates can reach consuming components. None of the 7 acceptance criteria about live updates can be satisfied.
issues.suggestedFix: The onEntryChange callback must capture the entry data from the SDK and merge it into the content tree. Per the prescribed fix, the callback should receive the updated entry and deep-merge it into the context value so all 236+ consuming components re-render with the preview data. Investigate the SDK's actual callback signature — it may provide the entry as an argument or via a separate method like `LivePreview.getEntry()`.

issues.description: useContent.getContentByKey has no live preview override logic — it just calls `getValue(content, path, defaultValue)`. Even if the ContentstackProvider captured preview data, no component would see it because getContentByKey never consults any preview override bag. The diff also REMOVES the `livePreview` field from IContentstackContext and removes the override lookup, which is the opposite of the prescribed fix.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore the live preview override lookup in getContentByKey. The hook should check for preview overrides before falling back to published content via getValue, as the prescribed fix states: 'merge defaultContent with live preview updates' so all downstream consumers re-render.

issues.description: No server-side Contentstack Stack initialization with live_preview configuration. The prescribed fix requires `live_preview: { enable: true, preview_token: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, host: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST }` so that preview queries return draft content. Without this, the SDK may initialize on the client but the Contentstack API will never return draft/preview content, making the entire feature non-functional end-to-end.
issues.suggestedFix: Locate the Contentstack Stack initialization (likely in cx-shared or an API util) and add the live_preview configuration object with preview_token and host from environment variables.

issues.description: useLivePreviewContent is dead code — it is not consumed by any component or exported through the hooks barrel. Its implementation also has the same onEntryChange discard bug (`setContent((prev) => ({ ...prev } as T))`). This adds complexity without meeting any acceptance criterion.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove useLivePreviewContent entirely. The live preview subscription should live in ContentstackProvider (the single source of content truth) per the prescribed fix, not in a separate hook that nobody calls.

issues.description: No unit tests exist for any of the 4 changed files. resolve_test_file confirmed zero test files for contentstackContext.tsx, useContent.ts, ContentstackLink.tsx, or contentCard.ts. The review criteria require new features to have corresponding vitest unit tests mirroring the src/ path, and the total test count must not decrease. None of the 7 acceptance criteria are covered by tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Add unit tests for: (1) ContentstackProvider — verifies onEntryChange triggers re-render with updated content, verifies fallback to defaultContent when preview inactive, verifies cleanup on unmount; (2) useContent — verifies getContentByKey returns preview overrides when present and falls back to published content; (3) ContentstackLink — verifies data-cslp attribute in preview mode, verifies link renders published content in production.

issues.description: Unused variable `context` — `const context = useContext(ContentstackContext)` is declared but never read. This is a TypeScript strict compliance issue (noUnusedLocals) and indicates the component was not properly refactored. The component also duplicates preview detection logic (window.location.search.includes) that should live in the provider.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the unused `context` variable. Move preview detection into ContentstackProvider and expose `isPreviewEnabled` through context so components don't hand-roll URL parsing.

issues.description: Hardcoded string literals `"live_preview"` and `"preview_token"` for URL parameter detection. Review criteria require no hardcoded strings for file paths, endpoints, or configuration keys — all should use named constants from src/config/constants.ts.
issues.suggestedFix: Define LIVE_PREVIEW_QUERY_PARAM and PREVIEW_TOKEN_QUERY_PARAM constants in src/config/constants.ts and import them.

issues.description: ContentstackLivePreview.init() is called unconditionally on every page load, including production. The prescribed fix says preview should only activate when a preview session is active. This risks errors on production pages and violates AC: 'On a production page with no Contentstack Live Preview session active, the page renders all content as static published content with no visible Live Preview indicators.'
